summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_id and client_secret; field sources per spec; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var refs for both secrets, with profile args applied before them). Exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and placed it in profile_mappings directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim, token-over-OAuth selection, OAuth selection, profile output, override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run, per instructions. Nothing committed. Known edge case: if a caller passes client_id or client_secret in profile_args, env_vars reports the caller's value because the base class resolves profile args first; left unchanged since the base class is out of scope.
